quizzes.question: Final test didn't detect a half-seated battery connector. What kind of cause is that?
quizzes.explanation: The defect was made earlier (occurrence). The escape cause explains why the detection barrier — here, final test — didn't catch it.

quizzes.question: 30 cartons got wrong labels and someone says “operator error”. What should the team do FIRST?
options: Retrain the operator and close it
Contain suspect cartons, then ask why the process allowed it
Put a reminder sign at packing
quizzes.explanation: Contain first, then find why the process allowed a wrong label at all. Retraining or a sign relies on memory, so it rarely stops a repeat.
